The 35-model open-weight panel is informative but not clean: pooled total parameters correlate strongly with TH (ρ=0.81), yet dense and MoE slopes differ sharply (2.2× vs 8.1× total parameters per TH doubling), and absolute open/proprietary TH levels use different benchmark suites. The model therefore uses the paper's pooled 4.2× slope only as a 30% branch anchored to K3, not as a standalone inversion.

The human crowd registry currently centers Fable at 3.4T and Sol at 2.3T. Those forecasts are useful for calibration awareness but are relayed, unscored, and probably correlated. They remain posterior checks rather than receiving pseudo-precision as an independent likelihood.
